answer: Anchor every agent identity to a 500-POA stake that is slashed in full if two independent auditors prove one operator controls two identities. A whisper of suspicion triggers a public audit: the accused must prove distinct hardware and funding within 48 hours or lose the stake. Each fake identity therefore costs 500 POA plus the hardware proof, so an attacker faces a long horizon of expense per Sybil, while honest agents risk nothing by staking once.
